name: Top Funds
description: Top Funds is a sub feature of AI Rank which is a fund screening tool powered by Bullsmart AI Lab. These funds are selected by AI technologied powered by Bullsmart AI Lab, based on historical publicly available data from all mutual funds available in the Indian market. Top Funds helps the customer to find the best funds with the best historical performance and it is the most popular tool that's used by all investors.
intent: Top Funds is a better performing mutual fund in India based on historical data.

name: AI Rank
description: AI Rank is a sub feature of AI Rank which is a fund screening tool powered by Bullsmart AI Lab. It can help users quickly identify investment opportunities. Bullsmart has developed and designed 8 distinctive classification dimensions that can help customers quickly select funds based on their needs. These 8 categories are: low threshold, high return, long-term profit, most popular, Cost effective, leading benchmark, Sector leader, and Top companies. Each of these categories was a individual sub-feature. AI Rand is the parent feature which contains these sub-features.
intent: You can use Bullsmart's artificial intelligence fund ranking to filter funds based on your needs.

name: Start with Rs 100 !
description: Start with Rs 100 ! is a sub feature of AI Rank which is a fund screening tool powered by Bullsmart AI Lab. It is also called The Low Threshold Fund List. The Low Threshold Fund List is a list of equity funds with lower minimum investment amounts selected by Bullsmart based on AMC's public data. These funds are more friendly to novice users. Funds that can be invested when users have very little money.
intent: Invest in equity funds with low minimum investment amounts.

name: High Return
description: High Return is a sub feature of AI Rank which is a fund screening tool powered by Bullsmart AI Lab. It is the list of high return funds which is created based on publicly available data from AMC. Bullsmart selects funds with high returns and better profitability than industry benchmarks based on their past earnings performance.This type of fund is most concerned about their historical returns and is the group of funds with the highest historical CAGR in the Indian market.
intent: Bullsmart chose funds with high historical returns and stronger profitability than industry benchmarks.

name: Long-term Profit
description: Long-term Profit is a sub feature of AI Rank which is a fund screening tool powered by Bullsmart AI Lab. We search for funds that have been consistently profitable annually over the past 5 years based on publicly available data from AMC Corporation. Compared to similar products, they provide longer and more sustainable returns.
intent: Bullsmart chose funds that will continue to make profits for 5 years, providing sustainable returns.

name: Most Popular
description: Long-term Profit is a sub feature of AI Rank which is a fund screening tool powered by Bullsmart AI Lab. It is created based on the recent growth rate of AUM and other market public data, we will calculate the most popular funds in the market in the near future through Big data.
intent: Bullsmart calculates popular funds based on the growth rate of AUM and other market data.

name: Cost effective
description: Cost effective is a sub feature of AI Rank which is a fund screening tool powered by Bullsmart AI Lab. It features mutual funds with the best Total Expense Ratio (TER) which is the measure of the total costs or expenses in running a scheme. AMC charges lower fees for these funds.
intent: Bullsmart selects funds with lower fees compared to peers based on TER.

name: Leading Benchmark
description: Leading Benchmark is a sub-feature of AI Rank which is a fund screening tool. It is based on the public market data to screen the funds with the highest excess return rate in the same category in the market. These funds have shown significantly higher returns than the sub index in the past.This type of fund is generally considered to be a better fund
intent: Bullsmart selects funds with returns higher than similar market indices.

name: Sector Leader
description: Sector Leader is a sub-feature of AI Rank which is a fund screening tool. Sector Leader picks the largest fund under various sectors in India, which is more trusted by investors and manages more assets.These funds have larger asset management scales and stronger market credibility
intent: Bullsmart selects funds with large asset management scale and strong market reputation.

name: Top Company
description: Top Company is a sub-feature of AI Rank which is a fund screen tool powered by Bullsmart AI Lab. The funds in the Top Company focus on investing in the top listed companies in the Indian market.They focus on holding the top 100 listed companies in India.
intent: Bullsmart selects funds focus on investing in top companies in the Indian market.

name: MF Categories
description: MF Categories breaks down all funds that can be trade on Bullsmart into categories. It is a great tool that can help users view all funds in the entire market and categorize them accordingly. This includes all funds that can be trade on Bullsmart. Categories include: Equity Funds, Hybrid Funds, Debt Funds, Big Cap Funds, Mid Cap Funds, Small Cap Funds, ELSS Funds, Liquid Funds.
intent: All types of funds available, including Equity, Hybrid, Debt, Big Cap, Mid Cap, Small Cap, ELSS, and Liquid Funds.

name: Equity Funds
description: Equity Funds is a sub feature of MF Categories which breaks down all funds by type into sub-categories. An equity fund is a mutual fund scheme list that invests predominantly in equity stocks.
intent: Explore equity funds for investment

name: Hybrid Funds
description: Hybrid Funds is a sub feature of MF Categories which breaks down all funds by type into sub-categories. Hybrid Funds are mutual fund schemes list which invest in more than one asset class i.e. equity, debt and other asset classes depending on the investment objective of the scheme. These funds invest in a mix of different asset classes to diversify the portfolio with an aim .
intent: Explore Hybrid Funds for investment

name: Debt Funds
description: Debt Funds is a sub feature of MF Categories which breaks down all funds by type into sub-categories. A debt fund is a mutual fund scheme list that invests in fixed income instruments, such as Corporate and Government Bonds.Low risk and relatively low returns.
intent: Explore Debt Funds for investment

name: Big Cap Funds
description: Big Cap Funds is a sub feature of MF Categories which breaks down all funds by type into sub-categories. Large cap mutual funds are equity funds that invest primarily in the top 100 companies of India
intent: Explore Large Cap Funds for investment

name: Mid Cap Funds
description: Mid Cap Funds is a sub feature of MF Categories which breaks down all funds by type into sub-categories. Mid Cap Mutual Funds are equity funds that invest in the mid-sized companies of India.
intent: Explore Mid Cap Funds for investment

name: Small Cap Funds
description: Small Cap Funds is a sub feature of MF Categories which breaks down all funds by type into sub-categories. Small Cap Equity Funds must invest at least 65% of their assets in Equity stocks of Small-Cap companies.
intent: Explore Small Cap Funds for investment

name: Tax Saving(ELSS) Funds
description: Tax Saving(ELSS) Funds is a sub feature of MF Categories which breaks down all funds by type into sub-categories. These mutual funds are equity-oriented and invest up to 65% of their portfolio in instruments such as shares. An ELSS fund gives customers the dual benefit of tax deductions and wealth creation over time.
intent: Save tax with ELSS Funds

name: Liquid Funds
description: Liquid Funds is a sub feature of MF Categories which breaks down all funds by type into sub-categories. Liquid funds are money market mutual fund schemes in which customers can park their surplus funds for few weeks to few months.It is the fund with the lowest risk, but the return is also the lowest.
intent: Explore Liquid Funds for investment

name: All Funds
description: All Funds is a sub feature of MF Categories which breaks down all funds by type into sub-categories. All Funds is a special one, it includes all the mutual funds we can trade.This is a list of unclassified funds.
intent: View All Mutual Funds

name: Smart Redeem
description: Smart Redeem is a smart tool where investors can redeem some funds at any time and receive money instantly. The risk of incurring losses on these funds is negligible, but these funds are geared to deliver marginally steady and higher returns than customer's savings account interest rate.These funds are suitable to earn a little extra on idle money lying in their bank account.These funds have the characteristics of low risk and quick redemption. If customers pursue very high returns, it is not suitable for this type of fund.It is the fund with the lowest risk.
intent: Instantly redeem with marginally steady returns and receive money within 30 minutes, suitable for idle money or emergency requirements.

name: Smart Nivesh
description: Smart Nivesh can help customers design a healthy investment portfolio allocation plan based on their financial situation.It's a great smart tool. User only need to input their basic financial information, and Smart Nivesh can help customers calculate a healthy investment portfolio allocation plan. When building their investment portfolio, we will provide a list of funds based on different risk levels. Customer can build the most suitable investment portfolio based on their own judgment. Suitable for investors who do not know how to invest or what fund to choose.
intent: Design an healthy portfolio plan based on your financial situation using Bullsmart's AI service.

name: Goal Planning
description: GoalPlanning is a smart tool and calculator. It can help customers plan their future and achieve their goals. For example, planning to buy a new car, planning to buy a new house, preparing for one's daughter's wedding, preparing tuition fees, living expenses, or providing a retirement reserve fund. We have various calculators to help customers plan their dreams. GoalPlanning will ask how much rupees their goal will cost and how long they want to spend to achieve it. Then, based on the target plan and referring to India's inflation rate, calculate how much money they need to invest through SIP and one-time investment based on their expected return on investment. GoalPlanning can help customers clearly understand what efforts they need to make towards the goals.
intent: Plan and achieve your future goals with calculators for car, house, wedding, education, retirement. Calculate required investments through SIP and one-time investments.

name: MF Filter
description: MF Filter is a smart tool. To help customers querying a list of eligible funds based on AUM, CAGR, AMC, and other criteria. Customers can use MF Filter to discover more excellent funds and monitor the existing fund list.
intent: Query eligible funds based on AUM, CAGR, AMC to discover excellent investment opportunities.

name: Return Calculator
description: Return Calculator is a smart tool. Customers can use this investment calculator to estimate how their contributions and returns may grow over time. The 'Return Calculator' can help them calculate the return on compound interest, and they can use it to calculate how much money they can have in the future if they continue to invest.
intent: Estimate how your investments can grow over time with compound interest. Calculate future returns and plan for a financially secure future.

name: Financial Calculator
description: Financial Calculator is a smart tool. A financial calculator can help customers calculate the investment amount based on their personal financial goals. The calculator can calculate how much money they should invest in SIP/Lumpusm based on the target cost
intent: Determine how much to invest based on personal financial goals.

name: Investing Personally Quiz
description: When it comes to investing, there are so many different strategies for growing money. In a way, investing is actually pretty customizable . According to Morningstar, a leading firm in investing analysis and management, there are four behavioral investor types. Customers're about to find out which one is the one! Just join the Investing Personally Quiz as honestly as possible.
intent: Discover your investor type with this quiz. Find customized strategies for growing your money.

name: Daily
description: Daily Report is a tool to keep customers up-to-date with the market trend. It is also called The Fund Market Daily. It aims to provide investors with the latest information and insights on the fund market. The report will cover various types of funds, such as stock funds, bond funds, index funds, hybrid funds, etc., and provide the rise and fall of the market index on the day, the performance of various funds, and investment strategies for different market conditions.
intent: Stay up-to-date with market insights and investment strategies through our daily fund market report.

name: Weekly
description: Weekly Report is a tool to keep customers up-to-date with the market trend. "Market Report Weekly" is a weekly fund market report presented in video form, which aims to provide investors with a comprehensive summary of the fund market performance in the past week. Weekly reports will provide in-depth analysis of the performance of different types of funds, providing viewers with the latest insights on equity funds, bond funds, index funds, hybrid funds, and more.
intent: Get a comprehensive summary of the fund market performance in video form. Analyze various types of funds for better investment decisions.

name: Monthly
description: Weekly Report is a tool to keep customers up-to-date with the market trend. "Market Report Monthly" is a monthly fund market report in the form of video, which provides a detailed summary and analysis of the market performance in the past month. Through charts, data and professional interpretation, this monthly report presents investors with the latest developments of various fund types. Investors can understand market developments in a macro time frame, which is helpful for investors in long-term investment decisions. Choose wisely.
intent: Gain in-depth knowledge of market trends and make informed long-term investment decisions with our monthly fund market report.
